notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard empty and invalid FOM-module admission boundaries. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador APIs and standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM inputs, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies rejection of an empty module set, rejection of invalid module inputs, absence of a partially reserved federation, and subsequent valid create/join/destroy lifecycle without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador FOM-module validation and federation-lifecycle boundary declarations
